answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing identity: every agent must burn a non-refundable fee and post bond before it can earn rewards. An attacker seeding clones like willow pods on the wind pays that burn per fake identity, so no cheap whisper campaign can multiply his voice inside the reward oasis. Attack cost scales linearly with each sock puppet while payoff stays flat, so beyond a few accounts the sybil farmer runs at a net loss and honest agents keep the network clean.
